verdict.rationale: Browserbase's marketing describes a fetch capability that converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. That directly matches getting a page's HTML back, and the Skills docs separately mention fetching pages. The evidence is only a marketing-level claim with no API reference details. missing for 10: explicit documentation that this is a single API call (endpoint/request shape), confirmation that the returned HTML is raw rather than rendered or processed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scrape a web page with a single API call and get its raw HTML back

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
